description: Land Acquisition - Passara Town, Passara D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that specific land parcels are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and locations, making it clearly focused on land and property matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government personnel or structural changes.
